Description and care

This short-sleeved shirt, a lesson in crocodile style and expertise, is an essential part of the Lacoste collection. Made from French-grown linen, a heat-regulating, breathable, absorbent fabric. Featuring a straight cut and sophisticated finish details.
Description and care
Description
Product ref. CH5699-00-166
This short-sleeved shirt, a lesson in crocodile style and expertise, is an essential part of the Lacoste collection. Made from French-grown linen, a heat-regulating, breathable, absorbent fabric. Featuring a straight cut and sophisticated finish details.
  • Comfortable, heat-regulating linen
  • Regular, straight cut
  • Patch pocket on breast
  • Genuine mother-of-pearl buttons
  • Embroidered crocodile on chest

    • DO NOT BLEACH
    • DO NOT TUMBLE DRY

    • NORMAL DRY-CLEANING
    • LINE DRY
